stem: On a 50-question test, each correct answer earns 4 points, each incorrect answer loses 1 point, and each unanswered question earns 0 points. Elena answered 40 of the questions and received a score of 110 points. How many more questions did she answer correctly than incorrectly?
solution: Only answered questions count: let \(c\) be the correct answers and \(w\) the incorrect ones, so \(c + w = 40\) and \(4c - w = 110\).
She answered \(30 - 10 = 20\) more questions correctly than incorrectly.
verify:
c, w = symbols('c w')
sol = solve([c + w - 40, 4*c - w - 110], [c, w])
assert sol == {c: 30, w: 10}
assert [Rational(a) for a in spr_answers] == [sol[c] - sol[w]]
